create_docker_image: create a docker image for a given ML framework by building from the docker_images directory
test_framework_docker: test a framework docker container by sending various HTTP requests to validate inference endpoints
test_framework_invalid: test that a framework docker container returns error codes for invalid task and model inputs
test_framework_batch: run a batch inference test on a framework docker container using a HuggingFace dataset
use_docker_popen: use the DockerPopen context manager to run and auto-terminate a docker container process
